title: Emrys and the Parish
author: Gideon Marchetti
blurb: Marguerite Dravenmoor, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
